title: Grilled Aussie Melon Skewers
description: A refreshing and easy-to-make dessert perfect for hot summer days, featuring fresh Australian melon and a hint of outdoor grilled flavor.
instructions: Soak the wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Cut the Australian melon into 1-inch cubes.
Thread a melon cube, a piece of honey (if using), and a squeeze of lemon juice (if using) onto each skewer.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Preheat the grill to medium heat.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the melon is slightly caramelized.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh mint leaves if desired.
